privacyPolicyText: Sleep Reset keeps sleep check-in answers, breathwork history, and subscription access limited to the app experience. Sleep answers and breathwork progress are stored on-device. Purchases and subscription status are processed by Apple and RevenueCat to unlock premium features. We do not sell personal data. For privacy questions, contact support@sleepreset.app.
